newsitem.title: IRAN: Four dead in Iran quake relief plane crash-agency.
newsitem.headline: Four dead in Iran quake relief plane crash-agency.

text.p: Four people were killed when a small aircraft on a relief mission to Iran's quake-stricken northwest crashed, a local government official said on Tuesday.
Iran's official news agency IRNA quoted the official at Namin governorate in Ardabil province as saying the Falcon aircraft crashed on Monday night and all four people aboard were killed.
The agency quoted an official at the Namin governorate in Ardabil province as saying the aircraft crashed because of bad weather 25 km (16 miles) northeast of the city of Ardabil.
It said the plane had left Tehran for Ardabil on Monday night on a mission to assist victims of Friday's earthquake which killed nearly 1,000 people, injured 2,600 and left 35,000 homeless.
IRNA said search teams found the aircraft's wreckage in the Namin area on Tuesday.
The temperature in Ardabil has been reported as freezing with sporadic snowfalls in the past two days.
